eligibility: Related bundled street reallocation. Road space was narrowed for cycling and motor access restricted; a uniform moving-lane removal count has not been certified. Keep outside the clean lane-conversion cohort.
treatment: Cycle space widening, two bus-only links, turn restrictions, stops and signal changes, and a bus-route change.
timing: Trial began 1 October 2008. Bus GPS compares weeks 36–38 with 44–46; short adaptation window.
measurement: Automatic bus running times for three routes; GPS cycling segment times; bicycle/vehicle counts and parallel-street diversion. Bus passenger totals were not resolved in this report.
identification: Before/after evaluation, with seasonal cautions; no credible untreated comparison in the extracted running-time tables.
finding: All eight 5A/350S route-period means fell by 13–84 seconds. Cycling segment means were mixed (−8 to +38 seconds); rerouted 3A also had mixed results.
limit: Bus benefits cannot be assigned to bike lanes separately from bus priority and access restrictions. No matched total-person-flow or complete door-to-door time result. One printed bus difference is arithmetically inconsistent with its displayed means; corrected explicitly in our extract.
priority: Useful bus and bike time benchmark
